question: Who among the following is the author of the book '150 Years of Celebrating the Mahatma - the South African Legacy?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Fakir Hassen.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Fakir Hassen** is the author of the book **150 years of celebrating Mahatma the South African legacy.**

 
 
• It is launched in Johannesburg, South Africa.
 
• This book was released on the occasion of **Mahatma Gandhi’s 150th birth anniversary.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Frederic Tuten** is an American novelist, short story writer and essayist.

 
 
• He has written five novels:
 
 
• The Adventures of Mao on the Long March (1971)
 
• Tallien: A Brief Romance (1988)
 
• Tintin in the New World: A Romance (1993)
 
• Van Gogh's Bad Café (1997) and The Green Hour (2002).
 
 
 
 
 
• **Fareed Rafiq Zakaria** is an Indian-American journalist, political commentator, and author.
 
• **Daniel Woodrell** is an American novelist and short-story writer.
